translations.web: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
translations.bsb: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
translations.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
translations.asv: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
